messages:
csm_maya: FYI Kestrel Enterprises (acct KE-1179) is blocked after collections suspension — their CI pipelines failed. They say they uploaded a PO and had a card decline. Invoice INV-2026-1179.
ben_finance: On it. Drop the PO number + upload timestamp and gateway txn id if available.
alexa_support: PO in portal: PO-KE-9876, uploaded 2026-03-12 15:02 UTC. Sharing portal link via DM.
accounting_bot: Event logged: `payment_failed` for INV-2026-1179. Failure reason: `card_declined` (code 2003). Card last4: ****4242, exp: 03/26.
jordan_support: Card expired this month — explains decline. Customer claims PO obligates us to accept net terms. Can we grant access while they arrange payment?
lexi_collections: Collections policy summary: we need a cleared payment method or a verified PO on file. If PO is valid (signed and matches billing entity) we can provision net-30, but suspension is standard until verification. Need AP contact + explicit AP confirmation.
csm_maya: They pasted AP confirmation email: "we confirm PO-KE-9876, payment will be processed in 3 business days." AP contact: finance@kestrel.com (Lisa Marsh). Customer contact: tom@kestrel.com. They request immediate unfreeze.
ben_finance: Temporary unfreeze needs manager signoff. Send AP contact + confirmation. Also confirm there are no abuse flags. If we unfreeze and payment doesn't clear, we assume risk.
alexa_support: Uploaded screenshot of AP email to the case and DM'd the PO + invoice PDFs to finance.
legal_robin: Quick legal flag: confirm that PO references the same legal entity we invoice. If PO has differing terms, legal needs to sign off before we accept invoice under PO terms.
lexi_collections: Proposed steps: 1) Verify PO signature + corporate entity; 2) Call AP contact for payment ETA; 3) If verified, grant a one-time 48h provisional access; 4) Add AR watch note and monitor.
jordan_support: I'll run entitlement + abuse checks. If collections approves, I can lift for a 48h window and add case notes. DM me the documents.
ben_finance: I have the PO PDF. Signature is an initialed stamp  need legal confirmation. Also ask them to update the payment method as backup (card expired).
legal_robin: Reviewing PO now. If PO entity equals invoice entity and AP email is corporate, I can approve provisional acceptance. ETA ~90m.
csm_maya: Customer pinged: "Please lift access; our nightly batch fails otherwise." I replied we're reviewing and to expect an update soon.
accounting_bot: Reminder: dunning email #3 scheduled in ~14 hours unless payment clears.
lexi_collections: Calling AP now, will post notes.
lexi_collections: Call notes: spoke with Lisa Marsh (AP). She confirmed PO-KE-9876 is approved and payment is scheduled for 2026-03-15. Requested invoice PDF and remittance details (which I provided).
ben_finance: Given AP commitment to 03/15, approve provisional access contingent on legal signoff. Jordan, lift for 48h starting 2026-03-12T16:00Z and add a case note: "Provisional access on AP commitment; payment ETA 2026-03-15; contact finance@kestrel.com."
jordan_support: Done  suspension lifted at 2026-03-12T16:05Z. Added case note and #collections tag. Applied 48h window.
csm_maya: Customer confirms jobs resumed. They sent thanks :thumbsup:
legal_robin: PO review complete: legal entity matches invoice and signature is acceptable for provisional acceptance.
lexi_collections: I'll monitor payments. If no receipt by 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC, we re-apply suspension and continue dunning.
ben_finance: Marking INV-2026-1179 as "provisional access" and adding to AR watchlist AR-4521. Accounting will follow up for remittance.
accounting_bot: AR note created: AR-4521 (watchlist). Next automated dunning job queued for 2026-03-16.
csm_maya: Thanks all. I'll close the customer loop and propose a faster PO-verification checklist for future escalations.
ben_finance: Agreed  I'll draft a checklist to reduce time-to-decision on provisional unfreezes.
